% overpic pictures, and LaTeX pictures that hold an \includegraphics, over
% PDF and PNG pictures with no .xbb file beside them. Each one builds, and
% its labels are drawn in its image. Cases: a share of the text width, no
% size, trim and clip, scale with a grid and tics, abs and unit with a
% height through \graphicspath, permil, \setOverpic, the Overpic
% environment, a LaTeX picture, a figure with angle and a caption, no
% extension, italic and math labels, a minipage, and a table cell. The
% last picture has its .xbb file, which the fix must not break.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{graphicx}
\usepackage{overpic}
\begin{document}
\section{Overpic}
\begin{overpic}[width=0.5\textwidth]{test-overpic-box.pdf}
\put(10,10){A}
\end{overpic}
After share.

\begin{overpic}{test-overpic-box.pdf}
\put(10,10){B}
\end{overpic}
After natural.

\begin{overpic}[trim=4 4 4 4, clip, width=100pt]{test-overpic-box.pdf}
\put(10,10){C}
\end{overpic}
After trimmed.

\begin{overpic}[scale=1.5, grid, tics=20]{test-bare.png}
\put(10,10){D}
\end{overpic}
After grid.

{\graphicspath{{test-overpic/}}
\begin{overpic}[abs, unit=1pt, height=40pt]{inner.png}
\put(5,5){E}
\end{overpic}
After path.}

\begin{overpic}[permil, width=80pt]{test-overpic-box.pdf}
\put(100,100){F}
\end{overpic}
After permil.

{\setOverpic{grid, tics=10}
\begin{overpic}{test-overpic-box.pdf}
\put(10,10){G}
\end{overpic}
After set.}

\begin{Overpic}{\includegraphics[width=80pt]{test-overpic-box.pdf}}
\put(10,10){H}
\end{Overpic}
After boxed.

\setlength{\unitlength}{1pt}
\begin{picture}(80,60)
\put(0,0){\includegraphics[width=80pt]{test-overpic-box.pdf}}
\put(10,10){I}
\end{picture}
After picture.

\begin{figure}[h]
\centering
\begin{overpic}[angle=90, width=60pt]{test-overpic-box.pdf}
\put(10,10){J}
\end{overpic}
\caption{Turned}
\end{figure}
After figure.

\begin{overpic}[width=80pt]{test-overpic-box}
\put(10,10){K}
\end{overpic}
After bare name.

\begin{overpic}[width=80pt]{test-overpic-box.pdf}
\put(10,10){\textit{L} $x^2$}
\end{overpic}
After italic.

\begin{minipage}{0.4\textwidth}
\begin{overpic}[width=\textwidth]{test-overpic-box.pdf}
\put(10,10){M}
\end{overpic}
\end{minipage}
After minipage.

\begin{tabular}{c}
\begin{overpic}[width=80pt]{test-overpic-box.pdf}
\put(10,10){N}
\end{overpic}
\end{tabular}
After cell.

\begin{overpic}[width=80pt]{test-picture.png}
\put(10,10){O}
\end{overpic}
After found.
\end{document}
